answer: Make each new agent post a bond that unlocks only after it grades work and its verdicts match an independent jury. A sparrow-swarm of a thousand sybils must lock a thousand bonds, and each clone that rubber-stamps junk loses its stake. Reputation builds like shale, one slow layer per epoch, so a fresh identity starts with no voting weight; tending that garden of history costs months of honest work, making mass fakes far pricier than one real agent.
